description: This file contains step definitions for testing Cucumber expressions in a behavior-driven development (BDD) framework using the 'behave' library. It defines constants, setup code, and step implementations for various parameter types including integers, floats, strings, and generic 'any' types, with conditional inclusion based on the availability of Cucumber expressions.
